description: Allowlist of canonical axiom-premise nodes. Each entry binds a STABLE un-dated claim_id to the current (possibly dated) source-doc path. build_citation_graph.py canonicalizes the claim_id of any listed path to the stable id, so inbound citation edges and the premise status survive re-dating of the source doc. PR3 attaches the axiom_premise meta-subtype + auditor carve-out to these ids; PR3's structural guard enforces that each listed doc contains only axiom content (no framework-rule / ratification clauses).

minimal_axioms.note: Canonical A1+A2 axiom node. The source path may be re-dated; on re-date, update current_path and append the old path to aliased_paths so existing markdown links keep resolving to this stable id.
